about: TEMPLATE ONLY. This file is the schema for an INDEPENDENT holdout set: requests written by someone other than the builder, in their own words, with simple expected answers written BEFORE any run. The two rows below are marked FORMAT ONLY: they show the shape and must be deleted and replaced by the author's own rows (see docs/eval/HOLDOUT-INSTRUCTIONS.md). scripts/score_holdout.py refuses to run while any FORMAT ONLY row remains. expected.budget is an amount and a currency code (the city's own currency or its display currency); must_visit_names and skip_names are place names exactly as the app shows them; ambiguous lists fragments that should be reported as unclear, not guessed; wrong_city is the id of the city the request is really about (or the word unsupported for a city the app does not have). author_role says who wrote the row; written_on is the date (YYYY-MM-DD).
